reviewByArea.message: No systematic pattern in the residuals.
Trend: residuals fall with amount (r = -0.89); the model (e.g. through origin) may not suit the data.
Curvature: residuals form a U (middle below, ends above) pattern, so the response is not linear over this range. Consider a polynomial model or a narrower range.
Too few standards (3) to judge a residual pattern; at least 4 are needed.
